description: Delete a hosted image by id (from list_media). Its url stops working within minutes everywhere it is used: in email already delivered, and in any template, campaign or automation step that still references it, where it shows as a broken image. Nothing checks for references, and it cannot be undone, so delete only an image no message uses. Answers 404 not_found for an id that is not an image in this workspace.

id.description: The image's id from list_media, not its filename or URL

name: delete_media
